scope.supports: A universal no-Int-valued-assignment theorem on the fixed nine tetrads and an exact normalized real-symmetric frame-function counterexample to PSD sufficiency.
scope.does_not_support: Arbitrary complex-Hermitian frame systems, general even-parity sufficiency, or a fully instantiated refined-carrier operad.
scope.narrowest_claim: Literal universal integer parity, full measured-ray/source scaled checks, and the independently verified normalized M_bad/2 countermodel with a negative quadratic direction.
scope.next_test: Batch review must compare the source scaled integer checks with actual rational readouts and preserve the even-control limitation.
